subject: MedVector packaging options — tier tiling and feature sculpting
messages:
From: Claire Hsu <claire@medvector.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus@medvector.ai>
Date: 2028-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging review request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We're trying to rework our plan ahead of Q4 — objective is to shave ~30% off our monthly spend without harming peak latency on our triage workflows. Current constraints: private deployment (VPC), audit logs retained 12 months, model pinning to a single open model, ability to reserve burst capacity during 8–10am PST spike, and SSO + SCIM.

Questions:
- Can you show a clear upgrade/downgrade path if we need to scale capacity down during non-peak months?
- What feature bundles are locked into a Dedicated commitment vs available as add-ons?
- Do you have a suggested composition that hits our cost target while keeping the latency SLO?

We can do a short call if it's easier — I'm available tomorrow morning PST.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Hsu

claire@medvector.ai

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Claire Hsu <claire@medvector.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus@medvector.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-21T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging review request

Claire — great summary, thanks. High level we can get close to your target with a hybrid approach (reserved committed throughput + modular add-ons) and a one-time quantization exercise. Options below — quick read:

1) Baseline compact + burst credits (lowest commitment)
   - Hosted compact tier for 80% of baseline QPS (metered)
   - Pre-purchased burst credits for predictable 8–10am spikes (billed monthly)
   - Add-ons: VPC peering, 12mo audit log retention, model pinning (slot-based)
   - Pros: lowest upfront, easy downgrade path; Cons: higher per-token unit cost during heavy sustained usage
   - Ballpark: $18k/mo commit + $0.018/peak-token overage (approx)

2) Dedicated steady + addon modularization (recommended for stable peaks)
   - Dedicated pool sized for your 8–10am 95th percentile with autoscale cushion
   - Feature bundle: audit logs, SSO/SCIM, model pinning included in Dedicated SKU
   - Add-ons: additional burst slices (on-demand at discounted rate), extended retention
   - Pros: predictable latency SLO (p99 target 200–300ms depending on model), better unit economics at scale
   - Ballpark: $36k/mo reserved + metered burst credits; commit term improves rate

3) Hybrid private control plane (Private)
   - Private control plane + VPC connectors; on-prem inference option for regulated pipelines
   - Best fit if you need strict network isolation and audit evidence
   - Ballpark: custom pricing; ops uplift applies

Feature bundling guidance:
- Audit logs, SSO/SCIM, and model pinning are bundled with Dedicated and Private. For compact/hosted, those are available as add-ons (line-item).
- Quantization work (int8) can be scoped as a one-time project that reduces token cost 20–35% for many transformer models. We recommend a short eval run on a representative prompt set.

Upgrade/downgrade path:
- You can start on option (1) and move to (2) via a straightforward SKU change + provisioned pool creation. Billing for Dedicated starts at the activation hour; we support pro-rated transitions and a 30-day cooling window. Downgrade from Dedicated to Compact is permitted at renewal with a 60-day notice (to avoid stranded reserved capacity charges).

Next steps:
- I've attached a draft SOW (MedVector_SOW_v2.pdf) and a feature-matrix (feature-matrix.xlsx) mapping: which features are bundled vs add-ons.
- If you like, propose 30 minutes tomorrow 9–10am or 1–2pm PST and I'll bring karthik for any commercial questions.

Quick note on discounts: standard commercial team can approve up to 15% on the table. Anything beyond that requires manager approval — I'll loop Kar for >15%.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0187

From: Marcus Lee <marcus@medvector.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Claire Hsu <claire@medvector.ai>
Date: 2028-08-21T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging review request

Thanks Olga — quick clarifying items:
1) For option (2) Dedicated steady — is the p99 latency guarantee written into the SLA for the committed pool or is that an operational target? We need contractual language for p99 under sustained 4–6k tokens/sec.
2) For the quantization note — what is the expected model-quality delta for our default QA prompts? We can run a short eval but want an expectation.
3) On discounts — your 15% standard band is OK but our procurement team will push for net 30% (they have internal targets). If you can use a term play (12 month commit + a start-of-term payment), can you get closer to 25–30%?

Also please confirm: if we start on option (1) and convert to Dedicated mid-contract, are any credits applied toward the Dedicated reserve?

Cheers,
Marcus
VP Eng, MedVector
marcus@medvector.ai

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Packaging review request

Marcus — thanks, answers inline below and I've attached a short appendix in the feature matrix for the quantization tradeoffs.

1) SLA and p99 language:
   - Dedicated pools have an SLA section we can add to the SOW: guaranteed p99 latency target of 350ms for the pinned open-model under the committed pool characteristics (model + sequence length profile). We will add a pass/fail measurement harness and a remediation credit schedule. I'll ask Legal to include firm SLA language in SOW v2.

2) Quantization quality delta:
   - Typical models: int8 quant usually shows 1–3% relative degradation on NLU classification metrics; generative tasks vary more. With your triage prompts we'll expect low semantic drift, but we'll run the eval on your sample prompts and include a holdout set. Appendix (feature-matrix.xlsx -> sheet "QuantEval") shows sample deltas from previous customers.

3) Discount path and credit portability:
   - Short answer: yes, credits can be applied toward Dedicated reserve within 90 days of conversion (we'll pro-rate based on remaining credit balance).
   - Commercial offer: we can propose a 12-month committed Dedicated plan with a 18% one-time discount on the reserved fee if you sign SOW v2 by Aug 30. I don't have latitude to go to 25% without escalation.

I've attached the updated SOW (MedVector_SOW_v2.pdf) with SLA language stubbed and an updated feature-matrix mapping quantization. Looping Kar (commercial) and Laura (legal) to confirm the approval path and any redlines.

Proposed 30-min call to align on final tradeoffs: Aug 23 9:00am PST or Aug 23 11:00am PST — what works?

Best,
Olga
